name: 01 - End-to-End Transportation Process
purpose: High-level algorithm from operational setup to completed passenger ride.

nodes.text: Start ParaGO operation
Admin configures drivers, jeepneys, routes, stops, fares, and terminal settings
Driver goes online and starts an assigned route or terminal trip
Passenger selects route, pickup type and points; previews jeepneys
System validates and assigns the pickup request to an eligible trip
Driver acknowledges the assigned request
Passenger boards manually or through confirmed proximity
System tracks the ride, location, occupancy, and notifications
Optional digital para; continue ride if no alert
Passenger unloads manually or through confirmed separation
Complete ride and decrease occupancy; reports query saved records
End of passenger ride
